items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: He’s still around, God bless him. He was at Fat Tuesday’s when we were there and that was in the eighties, yes in the eighties was the last time I saw him.

ctx.x: He’s still around, God bless him. He was at Fat Tuesday’s when we were there and that was in the eighties, yes in the eighties was the last time I saw him. He was the highest paid jazz guitarist on recording, I guess you know that, right?
